title: rhamnus atlantica
intro: Rhamnus atlantica, commonly known as Atlas Cedar or Atlantic Bayberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. This shrub or small tree is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus atlantica include its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
